scope: Opt-in offline AppContainer execution for source-owned verification commands; no model-provider capability change or production activation.

contract.workspace: Package-specific modify ACL on the isolated verification copy only
contract.pinned_inputs: Hash-checked independent read/execute copies, 512 MiB actual-byte copy limit
contract.job_limits: 64 MiB to 2 GiB aggregate memory; 1 to 64 active processes; original timeout and output limits retained
success_requires: actual AppContainer token/SID and zero capabilities
contract.ordinary_legacy_config: Unchanged trusted-host execution; filesystem_sandbox remains false
